release_notes:
- Library: opening a library is faster, above all on Windows laptops. Each click used to load the table three times; now it loads once.
- Library: clicking several libraries in a row now opens exactly the one you clicked last. On slower computers Nexus SR could open the wrong library, repeat earlier clicks, or keep jumping between two libraries by itself.
- Library: clicking the library that is already open no longer unmarks it.
- Windows: saving your work (screening decisions, ratings, imports...) no longer waits for the disk to confirm every single change, which made it much slower than on Mac.
